about: Work-window thresholds (spraying, sowing, field traffic, fertiliser timing). Every value carries a source and 'verified'. verified:false = the owner has not yet checked it against the source; the UI labels the windows 'thresholds awaiting verification'. quantified:false = the source gives only qualitative guidance (or none for the number) and the value is a placeholder to replace. Conditions only: no product advice, no doses; the product label's rain-fast interval always overrides. SI units (m/s, C, mm, h).
